rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Universal code execution MCP server providing secure sandboxed execution of TypeScript and Python code with progressive disclosure capabilities achieving 98% token savings. Generates ergonomic wrapper functions for MCP tools instead of exposing raw schemas. Features Docker-based security with AppArmor profiles, seccomp filtering, and resource limits. Real-time output streaming via WebSocket, comprehensive audit logging, and automatic wrapper generation with sensible defaults and state management. Uses Deno for TypeScript execution with STDIO and HTTP MCP transports.
